## Beauty Brass — G4

**Who she is.** The pale-blue **sousaphone player** in Octavia Melody’s four-pony ensemble at the Grand Galloping Gala. She joins Octavia, pianist Frederick Horseshoepin, and harpist Parish Nandermane when Pinkie Pie demands the **“Pony Pokey.”**

**Appearance.** Light arctic-blue Earth-pony mare; brown/grayish-amber swept mane and tail; lilac-purple eyes; pink bow tie; an **F-clef (bass-clef) cutie mark**. Her oversized golden sousaphone is the easiest identifier.

**Name.** The series never calls her *Beauty Brass* aloud. The name appears in fan discussion by **May 20, 2011** and was subsequently used in the licensed **Gameloft My Little Pony mobile game** (added with update 2.1, June 2013). Thus it is an early fandom name also adopted by licensed media—not a spoken television name. No verified alter ego.

**Appearances.** *The Best Night Ever* (S1E26, gala band); *Equestria Games* (S4E24, brief spectator cameo); and *My Little Pony: The Movie* (2017, Friendship Festival musical cameo). The Gameloft game also makes her playable.

**Speaking.** No verified individual dialogue or credited voice actor in the show; playing the sousaphone is not a speaking role. Any dialogue in fan fiction belongs to its own fan continuity.
